_approach: Krushclub's TikTok-optimised song structure (EDMProd: short, punchy, straight to the hook) favours a hard stop over a long ramp: the hat roll and clap stutter build for a bar and a half, then everything cuts to total silence for the last three 16ths before one final kick+clap+crash hit — the 'stutter-stop' internet-EDM cousin of hard techno's build-and-pause, compressed to fit a 2-minute song.
